'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jonny Chu DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Chu
* '''Deck name:''' Texxere + Schmuck(?)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
